body.heading: Make your character
paragraphs: Ask your adult to prepare a clean, empty eggshell or use a small pot. Draw a funny face on it with the marker.
Fill the shell with damp cotton wool and sprinkle cress seeds on top. Keep the cotton wool damp, like a wrung-out sponge.

body.heading: Hair that grows
paragraphs: Put your character on a sunny windowsill. In a day or two, tiny white roots appear. Then green shoots push up — your character is growing hair.
Cress grows very fast. In about a week, your friend will have a wild green hairstyle that needs a trim.

body.heading: The haircut
paragraphs: When the cress is tall, give your character a haircut with scissors — an adult can help with the cutting.
Plants need light, water, and time. Your cress head shows all three at work on one small windowsill.

takeaway: Cress grows so fast you can watch it turn seeds into a green hairstyle in about a week.
materials: An empty eggshell or small pot (an adult prepares)
safetyNotes: An adult should crack and clean the eggshell — the edges can be sharp. Wash hands after handling seeds, and only taste cress if an adult says it is safe and has washed it first.
screenFreeExtension: Draw a different face on each pot and hold a cress-hair fashion show at the end of the week.
